newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks seen lower at start.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks seen lower at start.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to open lower with bonds on Wednesday as the market sees profit-taking following Tuesday's 135-point rally in the Dow industrials, analysts said.
They said that U.S. March capacity utilization and industrial production data, due at 1315 GMT, would set the tone for the bond and stock markets.
"We'll see some profit-taking at the start, which is only normal after yesterday's surge," said Peter Cardillo, director of research at Westfalia Investmenbts.
The long bond was down 2/32 to yield 7.10 percent.
